items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: We used to use Frank Crump. Frank Crump on clarinet and sax and I'd play sax and Albert Fernandez on trumpet. And George Guido on banjo. We had a good lineup down there.

ctx.x: That place is painted sort of a bluish green color, isn't it? No, it is.

Yeah, they sell some kind of furniture or something. Yeah. Well, man, we played on that corner, I guess, for about five, almost ten years. We used to go to Everside Night and on the object side, on the uptown, uptown, back of town corner, used to have a band used to play there. Had a wine store there, Phoenix wine store. Remember the Phoenix? Yeah, I know that part. Phoenix wine store. That's why you used to take the tin can and go in there and get your can of wine for a nickel, draw it yourself out the bar. I've…
I never heard anything like that myself lately.
